thread:
Carrie (CS): Morning — quick kickoff for OrchidCloud private/VPC onboarding. Scope: TGW attachment + route table propagation, firewall SR for control plane + telemetry, CMK policy to allow cross-account decrypt, audit logs to their bucket with 365d retention. Renewal watch: trial usage ~15% of commit; AE alert at 40%.

Nikhil (Customer): Egress CIDR will be 52.23.0.0/16 via NAT. Bucket orchid-redwood-logs created with prefix redwood/audit. Monthly KMS rotation ok. I'll DM bastion IPs and route IDs.

Omar (Net): Please provide TGW attach ID and private endpoint subnet IDs. For firewall SR we recommend opening outbound 443 and 5263 to control/telemetry CIDRs only. Healthcheck: /ready every 30s from our LB.

Sasha (Security): CMK policy currently blocks Redwood role. Draft snippet posted to ticket ORC-12 to allow arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/Redwood-Service limited to kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey. Also recommend enabling CloudTrail log validation for 365d export. Note cost impact for 365d retention.

GateBot: Ticket ORC-12 created: "orchidcloud priv-deploy: TGW routes, firewall SR, CMK patch" assigned to Omar, Sasha.

Carrie (CS): Actions: 1) Nikhil post TGW attach + route IDs + S3 bucket policy (Nikhil). 2) Omar file firewall SR and confirm LB healthcheck config (Omar). 3) Sasha post CMK policy diff and request final ARN if needed (Sasha). Goal: smoke test Thurs 10:00 PST.

Nikhil (Customer): Posting TGW attach att-0b2c3d4e and route rtb-0c1d2e3f now. Added PutObject permission for arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/Redwood-Service to bucket policy.

Omar (Net): SR-9921 opened for outbound 111.222.20.0/24:443 and 111.222.21.0/24:5263, healthcheck set to /ready. Will update ORC-12 when approved.

Sasha (Security): CMK policy diff posted in ORC-12. Asked Nikhil to confirm alias alias/orchid-priv-cmk. Also flagged option for 90-day rotation if they want stricter posture.

Carrie (CS): Thanks team. Noting risks: CMK alias mismatch and audit retention cost. I'll add renewal watch and escalate AE if usage crosses threshold. Closing thread unless blockers appear.
